description: This file defines a chat service module that provides functions to create chat completions and stop ongoing requests, interfacing with an API client to communicate with an AI service.

methods.name: createChatService()
methods.description: Factory function that returns an object with methods to create chat completions and stop ongoing requests.

methods.name: createCompletion
methods.description: Asynchronous function to initiate a chat completion request with parameters for message history, model, temperature, and streaming option.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Function to abort an ongoing chat completion request using an AbortController.
